name: BlackRock, Inc.

notes: 2Q26 revenue up 31% year on year, including HPS fees and higher performance fees
Adjusted operating margin 45.9%, the highest in almost five years
Net inflows of $192bn in 2Q26 (8% organic base fee growth) and $868bn over the last twelve months

eps_build.note: Base-case year-1 EPS growth of about 12% = 5% organic growth (management target) + 4% market appreciation + 1.5% operating leverage + 0.5% buybacks, compounded and rounded

thesis: Organic base fee growth of 10% over the last twelve months is twice management's 5% target, driven by ETFs, private markets and Aladdin.
The GIP and HPS acquisitions add higher-fee private markets revenue; the adjusted operating margin reached 45.9% in 2Q26.
Equity-market levels drive roughly half of revenue growth, so the stock carries market beta that a DCF must discount.
risks: A sustained equity-market decline (revenue tracks average AUM)
Integration of GIP and HPS, including retention of private-markets talent
Regulatory scrutiny of large index holders
